gbm_population_evidence.quote: Dietary Cysteine and Methionine Deprivation (CMD) in Glioma Patients

candidate_evidence.quote: Cysteine/methionine deprivation (CMD) diet for 2 days: Participants receive cysteine/methionine deprivation (CMD) diet for 2 days.
Normal diet: Participants receive normal diet.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The CMD diet will be implemented simultaneously in 2 cohorts of participants with recurrent glioma.

source_quote.quote: Change in tumor tissue glutathione metabolites: Local tumor tissue metabolite levels will be assessed in resected glioma specimens from patients in the surgical cohort following assigned diet

arms: Cohort A: Surgery Diet Restriction 2 days
Cohort A: Surgery Diet Restriction 4 days

coder_notes: Dietary intervention only (cysteine/methionine deprivation diet vs normal diet) before standard surgery or radiotherapy; phase NA. Diets are an excluded intervention type and are not drugs, so no agents listed. Glioblastoma multiforme named in conditions alongside recurrent glioma; eligibility does not restrict histology, so coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named. Tumour glutathione metabolite measurement is a pharmacodynamic endpoint of the diet, not of a drug candidate.
